   395  void Udp::HandlePayload(Message &aMessage, MessageInfo &aMessageInfo)
   396  {
   397      // find socket
   398      for (UdpSocket *socket = mSockets; socket; socket = socket->GetNext())
   399      {
   400          if (socket->GetSockName().mPort != aMessageInfo.GetSockPort())
   401          {
   402              continue;
   403          }
   404
   405          if (!aMessageInfo.GetSockAddr().IsMulticast() && !socket->GetSockName().GetAddress().IsUnspecified() &&
   406              socket->GetSockName().GetAddress() != aMessageInfo.GetSockAddr())
   407          {
   408              continue;
   409          }
   410
   411          // verify source if connected socket
   412          if (socket->GetPeerName().mPort != 0)
   413          {
   414              if (socket->GetPeerName().mPort != aMessageInfo.GetPeerPort())
   415              {
   416                  continue;
   417              }
   418
   419              if (!socket->GetPeerName().GetAddress().IsUnspecified() &&
   420                  socket->GetPeerName().GetAddress() != aMessageInfo.GetPeerAddr())
   421              {
   422                  continue;
   423              }
   424          }
   425
   426          aMessage.RemoveHeader(aMessage.GetOffset());
   427          assert(aMessage.GetOffset() == 0);
   428          socket->HandleUdpReceive(aMessage, aMessageInfo);
   429          break;

   433  void Udp::UpdateChecksum(Message &aMessage, uint16_t aChecksum)
   434  {
   435      aChecksum = aMessage.UpdateChecksum(aChecksum, aMessage.GetOffset(), aMessage.GetLength() - aMessage.GetOffset());
   436

   440      }
   441

   443      aMessage.Write(aMessage.GetOffset() + UdpHeader::GetChecksumOffset(), sizeof(aChecksum), &aChecksum);
